name: F-35 Lightning II
summary: Single-engine stealth multirole fighter flown in three versions by the Air Force, Marine Corps and Navy; now the most numerous US combat jet type.

wings: Mid-mounted trapezoidal wing with swept leading edge and gently forward-swept trailing edge
Wing and tail edges all set at matching angles for stealth
F-35C has a visibly larger wing with folding outer panels
engines: Single engine with one large round nozzle whose edge is serrated (sawtooth)
Bump-type diverterless intakes on each side behind the cockpit, with no splitter plate
F-35B shows a large hinged lift-fan door on the spine behind the canopy when hovering
fuselage: Wide, deep fuselage with a chined nose and smooth stealth panels
One-piece canopy with no bow frame, blending into a humped spine
Weapons carried internally; usually a clean underside with sawtooth-edged bay doors
tail: Twin outward-canted vertical fins mounted on the sides of the rear fuselage
All-moving horizontal tails that extend aft past the exhaust nozzle

tellTales: Twin canted fins straddling a single sawtooth-edged exhaust
Bulged intakes on the fuselage sides with no gap or splitter plate
Bulky, wide-bodied fighter with no external weapons or pylons

confusedWith.howToTell: The F-35 has one engine with a round nozzle and a much bulkier body; the F-22 is larger with two flat rectangular exhausts and wide-set fins.
The F-35 has twin canted fins and side intakes on a fat fuselage; the F-16 has a single fin and a chin intake under the nose.
The F-35 has one engine and bump intakes with no pylons; the Super Hornet has two side-by-side exhausts, rectangular intakes under big LERX and usually carries external stores.

usCount.source: F-35 Joint Program Office deliveries / FlightGlobal World Air Forces 2026
